standard_prerequisites.use: Specialized to Z = X and W = Y: the composition of the fundamental classes is the family of the fibred product, which is X itself.

core_obligations: Show [X/X/Y]_r circ [Y/Y/S]_e = [X/X/S]_{r+e} in z(X/S, r+e) for f and g flat of relative dimensions r and e (proof lines 3072-3074). This is the special case of lemma-construction-closed (tag 0H6M) with Z = X (a closed subscheme of itself, flat over Y of relative dimension r by hypothesis) and W = Y (a closed subscheme of itself, of relative dimension e over S by hypothesis): the fibred product Z x_Y W is X, so the composition is [X/X/S]_{r+e}, which is a relative (r+e)-cycle by the closed subscheme lemma (proof lines 3072-3073).
proof_roadmap: Read the fundamental classes as the closed subscheme constructions with Z = X and W = Y (statement lines 3065-3069).
Apply the closed composition lemma; the fibred product is X itself (proof lines 3072-3073).
